key_findings: The missing-parts question is causal, not merely anatomical: hands and eyes become absent or damaged for different reasons in different traditions.
Papyrus Chester Beatty I directly gives a contamination-linked hand excision: after Horus catches Seth's semen in his hands, Isis cuts the hands with a copper knife.

CT158/BD113 directly supplies a downstream hand-restoration pathway: Ra coordinates, Sobek searches and retrieves at the water using a snare/fish-trap, and Horus's mother makes the hands/arms grow in their place.
The causal bridge between the Chester Beatty hand-cutting episode and CT158/BD113 is a cross-text variant link and must not be rewritten as one continuous ancient instruction.
Papyrus Chester Beatty I directly gives forceful bilateral eye extraction by Seth followed by Hathor's gazelle-milk treatment and explicit inspection of healed eyes.
CT335/BD17 gives a separate fight-related wedjat injury restored by Thoth; CT157/BD112 gives a black-boar trauma variant with severe pain and loss of consciousness but not extraction.
The data reject a one-organ-one-restorer model: different traditions assign different damage and repair agents to the eyes, while the hand episode separates coordinator, retriever and regrowth agent.

causal_model.source_separation_rule: Edges from distinct textual variants remain distinct until an explicit primary-text bridge or controlled scholarly synthesis is supplied.

tool_vs_device_boundary.interpretation: Explicit tools and treatment materials are attested, but no stable treatment chamber, energy system, instrumentation, construction specification or recurring regenerative apparatus is observed.

highest_admissible_claim: Across admitted Horus traditions, body-part loss and damage have multiple explicit causes and multiple restoration pathways. The strongest combined model is a cause-sensitive distributed mythic restoration grammar. Hands provide an especially rich chain from contamination-linked excision in one narrative variant to water retrieval and regrowth in CT158/BD113, but those stages must remain source-separated. No regenerative machine or capsule is established.

requirements: Expand independently located Horus body-part damage/loss witnesses beyond hands and eyes.
Freeze CAUSE, DAMAGE_AGENT, DAMAGE_METHOD, PART_STATE, DISPLACEMENT_LOCATION, RECOVERY_AGENT, RESTORATION_AGENT, RESTORATION_METHOD and FINAL_STATE separately for every witness.
Keep manuscript variants separate before constructing any merged causal graph.
Search head/face, torso/chest, legs/feet, bones/skin and falcon anatomy without borrowing Osiris body-part traditions unless explicitly linked to Horus.
Test whether cause class predicts restoration pathway better than organ identity alone.
Only after the causal graph is stable rerun the device-signature test.
